question: Who among the following was the first chief guest to attend the Republic Day in 1950?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sukarno.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The first Republic Day Parade was held on 26 January 1950, during which the** President of Indonesia Sukarno was the chief guest.**
 
• Between 1950 and 1954, Republic Day parades were held at Irwin Stadium (now National Stadium), Kingsway, Red Fort and Ramlila Maidan.
 
• **Dr. Rajendra Prasad began his first tenure as President of the Indian Union on this day.**
 
• The President addresses the country on the eve of Republic Day.
 
• **The republic day celebrations are majorly divided into three parts i.e. the Republic Day Parade, the Beating Retreat, and the Award Distributions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• King of Bhutan Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck was the chief guest at the Republic Day celebrations twice in 1984 and 2005.
 
• King Tribhuvan Bir Bikram Shah of Nepal was the second Chief Guest of the Republic Day Parade in 1951.
 
• Governor-General Malik Ghulam Muhammad was the first person from Pakistan to attend the Republic Day Parade in 1955 at Rajpath, New Delhi as the chief guest.
